especes.nain: dwarf, stocky and broad-shouldered with a sturdy build and strong features
especes.elfe: elf, slender with long pointed ears, fine angular features and graceful bearing
especes.halfelin: halfling, a small human-like person with a youthful round face and ordinary rounded ears (not an elf, no pointed ears)
especes.gnome: gnome, a small person with a slightly oversized head, big bright curious eyes, expressive face and ordinary rounded ears
especes.tieffelin: tiefling, a human-like person with two horns curving from the forehead, unusual skin colour, slit or solid-coloured eyes and sharp features
especes.orc: orc, powerfully built with grey-green skin, a heavy jaw, two prominent lower tusks and pointed ears
especes.goliath: goliath, a giant-blooded person, very tall and muscular, grey stone-like skin with lighter patches and darker natural markings, a heavy brow and no horns
especes.drakeide: dragonborn, a humanoid with a scaled reptilian dragon-like head, a short snout, small horn-like frills, no wings, no hair, covered in fine metallic-sheen scales
